entries.en: You must unstrap the suitcase before opening its lid.
entries.zh: 你必须先解开行李箱的带子，再打开箱盖。

entries.en: The siblings agreed not to sell their patrimonial estate.
entries.zh: 兄弟姐妹们同意不出售祖传的庄园。

entries.en: The suffragan assisted the bishop during the crowded service.
entries.zh: 副主教在那场人数众多的礼拜仪式中协助主教。

entries.en: The legend follows a traveler who enters the otherworld through a cave.
entries.zh: 这个传说讲述了一个旅行者通过洞穴进入冥界的经历。

entries.en: The philosopher used conceptualism to explain how different objects can share a general name.
entries.zh: 这位哲学家用概念论解释不同物体为何能共用一个通称。

entries.en: Facial expressions provide nonlinguistic clues to a speaker's mood.
entries.zh: 面部表情提供了反映说话者情绪的非语言线索。

entries.en: What nincompoop left the freezer open all night?
entries.zh: 哪个傻子把冰柜开着放了一整夜？

entries.en: The similitude between the two signatures raised suspicions of forgery.
entries.zh: 两个签名的相似之处引发了对伪造的怀疑。

entries.en: The bumbler spilled the paint while trying to move the ladder.
entries.zh: 那个笨手笨脚的人想挪动梯子，却打翻了油漆。

entries.en: The embezzler concealed the missing funds behind a series of false invoices.
entries.zh: 盗用公款者用一连串假发票掩盖了资金的缺失。

entries.en: The receipt lists a subtotal before adding the delivery charge.
entries.zh: 收据先列出小计，再加上配送费。

entries.en: The quaintness of the little shop attracted visitors from the busy market.
entries.zh: 这家小店古雅有趣，吸引了热闹市场中的游客。

entries.en: Careful circumscription of the study area kept the survey manageable.
entries.zh: 仔细划定研究区域，使调查规模保持在可控范围内。

entries.en: The soldier took a paper cartouche from the leather pouch.
entries.zh: 士兵从皮袋里取出一个纸制火药筒。

entries.en: She stared dazedly at the wreckage of her bicycle.
entries.zh: 她茫然地盯着自己自行车的残骸。

entries.en: The polished surface produced a sharp specular reflection of the lamp.
entries.zh: 抛光的表面映出了灯具清晰的镜面反射像。

entries.en: Only the final line of the faded letter remained decipherable.
entries.zh: 这封褪色的信只有最后一行仍能辨读。

entries.en: The bridge collapsed that winter and was thenceforth closed to traffic.
entries.zh: 那座桥在那年冬天坍塌，此后便禁止通行。

entries.en: The laboratory tested the sample for uric acid.
entries.zh: 实验室检测了样本中的尿酸。

entries.en: The technician recorded the solution's titer beside the sample number.
entries.zh: 技术人员在样本编号旁记录了溶液的滴定度。

entries.en: The invitation was produced by letterpress on thick cream paper.
entries.zh: 这张请柬用活版印刷印在厚实的米色纸上。

entries.en: The bagman traveled between small towns with a case of fabric samples.
entries.zh: 推销员带着一箱布料样品往来于小镇之间。

entries.en: The limbless reptile slid beneath the warm stones.
entries.zh: 这只无肢爬行动物滑到了温暖的石块下面。

entries.en: The neurologist examined the electroencephalogram for unusual patterns.
entries.zh: 神经科医生检查脑电图是否存在异常模式。

entries.en: The actor secured a plummy role in the new production.
entries.zh: 这名演员在新剧中争取到了一个很好的角色。

entries.en: The researcher catalogued the different forms of the polymorphic species.
entries.zh: 研究人员把这个多形物种的不同形态编成了目录。

entries.en: The letter announced his intention to retire from the rabbinate.
entries.zh: 这封信宣布了他打算从拉比职位退休的意向。

entries.en: The section reveals the medullary cavity inside the long bone.
entries.zh: 这个切面显示了长骨内部的骨髓腔。

entries.en: The restored garden provides an exemplification of careful water management.
entries.zh: 修复后的花园为精心管理用水提供了一个例证。

entries.en: The dramatisation of the memoir required extensive changes to its structure.
entries.zh: 将这部回忆录改编为剧本，需要大幅调整其结构。

entries.en: We chose an unobjectionable title that every committee member could accept.
entries.zh: 我们选了一个不会招致反对、每位委员都能接受的标题。

entries.en: He handled the complaint ineptly and made the customer even angrier.
entries.zh: 他笨拙地处理了这次投诉，让顾客更加生气。

entries.en: Ignoring the repeated safety warnings was clearly blameworthy.
entries.zh: 无视反复发出的安全警告显然应受责备。

entries.en: The passengers spoke confusedly about which platform they should use.
entries.zh: 乘客们乱七八糟地谈论着应该去哪个站台。

entries.en: The athlete felt a sharp pain in the pectoralis while lifting.
entries.zh: 这名运动员举重时感到胸肌一阵刺痛。

entries.en: The busman waited until every passenger was seated before departing.
entries.zh: 公共汽车司机等所有乘客都坐好后才发车。

entries.en: The traveler hung a full wineskin from the saddle.
entries.zh: 旅行者把一个装满酒的酒囊挂在马鞍上。

entries.en: A bandsman polished his trumpet before the parade began.
entries.zh: 一位管乐队队员在游行开始前擦亮了自己的小号。

entries.en: The microscope slide shows a cell undergoing mitosis.
entries.zh: 这张显微镜玻片显示了一个正在进行有丝分裂的细胞。

entries.en: The dancer practiced a sideways chasse across the studio floor.
entries.zh: 舞者在练习室地板上练习了一个横向移动的快滑步。

entries.en: The merchandiser ordered more umbrellas after the rainy weekend.
entries.zh: 这位零售商在多雨的周末后又订购了一批雨伞。

entries.en: The craftsperson set the untempered blade aside for further treatment.
entries.zh: 工匠把未经回火的刀刃放在一边，留待进一步处理。

entries.en: The team compared the effects of two chemotherapeutic agents on cultured cells.
entries.zh: 团队比较了两种化疗药物对培养细胞的影响。

entries.en: The mechanic inspected the tailplane before checking the elevator.
entries.zh: 机械师先检查横尾翼，再检查升降舵。

entries.en: The instrument detected less than a nanogram of the substance.
entries.zh: 仪器检测到了不足一纳克的这种物质。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram labels the muscular sura below the knee.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了膝盖下方肌肉发达的小腿肚。

entries.en: An anonymous altruist paid for the shelter's new kitchen equipment.
entries.zh: 一位不具名的无私者出资购置了收容所的新厨房设备。

entries.en: She unselfishly gave up her seat so the tired passenger could rest.
entries.zh: 她无私地让出了座位，让疲惫的乘客休息。

entries.en: Visitors walked quietly around the white stupa on the hill.
entries.zh: 游客们安静地绕着山上的白色佛塔行走。

entries.en: The report portrayed the workers as undeserving of the bonus.
entries.zh: 报告把这些工人描述为不配获得奖金的人。

entries.en: The designer will kern the headline to close the awkward gaps.
entries.zh: 设计师将调整标题的字距，缩小不协调的空隙。

entries.en: The family history traces the matrilineage through several generations of women.
entries.zh: 这部家族史沿着几代女性追溯母系家族的世系。

entries.en: The nurse placed a sterile dilator on the instrument tray.
entries.zh: 护士把一个无菌扩张器放在器械盘上。

entries.en: I worried that nerves would make me flub the opening line.
entries.zh: 我担心紧张会让我说砸开场的第一句话。

entries.en: The slipperiness of the wet tiles forced us to walk slowly.
entries.zh: 湿瓷砖的滑溜让我们不得不慢慢走。

entries.en: The woodcarving depicts a bird perched on a twisted branch.
entries.zh: 这件木雕描绘了一只停在弯曲树枝上的鸟。

entries.en: An ambulance waited beside the hospital's rooftop heliport.
entries.zh: 一辆救护车在医院屋顶直升机机场旁等候。

entries.en: The council debated the teachings of the schismatic movement.
entries.zh: 会议讨论了这个分裂教会运动的教义。

entries.en: The petition asked the church to beatify the deceased nun.
entries.zh: 这份请愿书请求教会为已故修女举行宣福礼。

entries.en: Flood damage left the ground floor unlivable for several weeks.
entries.zh: 洪水造成的损坏使一楼连续几周无法居住。

entries.en: The groom led the nervous horse into the waiting horsebox.
entries.zh: 马夫把紧张的马牵进等候的运马拖车。

entries.en: After months of noise, they enjoyed the blessedness of a quiet home.
entries.zh: 经历了数月的嘈杂后，他们享受着安静家园带来的幸福。

entries.en: The paterfamilias called the household together to discuss the inheritance.
entries.zh: 这位男性家长召集全家讨论遗产问题。

entries.en: His usual cheerfulness gave way to sullenness after the argument.
entries.zh: 争吵之后，他往常的快活变成了闷闷不乐。

entries.en: The sales pitch was mostly abracadabra wrapped around an empty promise.
entries.zh: 这套推销说辞主要是围绕一个空洞承诺的胡言乱语。

entries.en: We shared a pot of oolong after the meal.
entries.zh: 饭后，我们一起喝了一壶乌龙茶。

entries.en: The analysis identified biogenic material within the ancient sediment.
entries.zh: 分析在古老的沉积物中发现了生物源物质。

entries.en: The diagram shows two oppositely positioned magnets beside the coil.
entries.zh: 图中显示了放在线圈旁、相对排列的两块磁铁。

entries.en: The museum's brougham has an open driver's seat and an enclosed passenger compartment.
entries.zh: 博物馆里的那辆旧式汽车有露天的驾驶座和封闭的乘客舱。

entries.en: The stall offered a few useful tools among piles of cheap dreck.
entries.zh: 这个摊位在一堆堆廉价破烂中摆着几件有用的工具。

entries.en: The observer adjusted the altazimuth before measuring the star's position.
entries.zh: 观测者先调整地平经纬仪，再测量恒星的位置。

entries.en: He finally threw away the holey socks he had kept for years.
entries.zh: 他终于扔掉了留了多年的破洞袜子。

entries.en: A crowded charabanc brought the visitors to the seaside hotel.
entries.zh: 一辆挤满人的大型游览车把游客送到了海滨旅馆。

entries.en: We gathered a basketful of apples beneath the oldest tree.
entries.zh: 我们在最老的那棵树下捡了满满一篮苹果。

entries.en: The borrowers struggled to repay loans carrying usurious interest rates.
entries.zh: 借款人艰难地偿还着利率高昂的贷款。

entries.en: The rival smiled malevolently as the fragile model fell apart.
entries.zh: 脆弱的模型散架时，竞争对手恶意地笑了。

entries.en: The technician monitored the solidification of the molten metal.
entries.zh: 技术人员监测了熔融金属的凝固过程。

entries.en: We refused to sleep on the skanky mattress in the abandoned cabin.
entries.zh: 我们不肯睡在废弃小屋里那张令人反感的床垫上。

entries.en: The artist arranged the portraits unconventionally along the floor.
entries.zh: 艺术家不依惯例地把肖像画沿地板排列。

entries.en: The archive contains veterinary reports describing outbreaks of rinderpest.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着描述牛瘟暴发的兽医报告。

entries.en: She sewed a loose summer shirt from pale blue chambray.
entries.zh: 她用浅蓝色钱布雷绸缝了一件宽松的夏季衬衫。

entries.en: The historical account describes flagellation as a punishment imposed on prisoners.
entries.zh: 这份历史记述把鞭打描述为施加于囚犯的一种惩罚。

entries.en: The river widened as we walked along its banks seawards.
entries.zh: 我们沿着河岸向海边走去，河面逐渐变宽。

entries.en: The pamphlet spread abolitionism through accounts of people escaping slavery.
entries.zh: 这本小册子通过讲述人们逃离奴役的经历传播废奴主义。

entries.en: The musician covered the chanter's finger holes to change the melody.
entries.zh: 乐手按住旋律管的指孔，改变了旋律。

entries.en: A sharp birdcall broke the silence above the marsh.
entries.zh: 一声尖锐的鸟叫打破了沼泽上方的寂静。

entries.en: The council considered three candidates for the vacant chancellorship.
entries.zh: 委员会考虑了三位竞争空缺长官职位的候选人。

entries.en: The program relies on the immutability of the original data.
entries.zh: 这个程序依赖原始数据的不变性。

entries.en: The loudest shouter could be heard above the entire crowd.
entries.zh: 最响亮的喊叫者的声音盖过了整个人群。

entries.en: The ostler brought fresh hay to the horses behind the inn.
entries.zh: 马夫给客栈后面的马送来了新鲜干草。

entries.en: The overambitious schedule left no time to repair unexpected faults.
entries.zh: 这个目标过高的日程没有留出时间修复意外故障。

entries.en: The laboratory develops microelectronic components for compact measuring instruments.
entries.zh: 这间实验室为小型测量仪器研发微电子元件。

entries.en: His unsought advice interrupted a conversation that was already difficult.
entries.zh: 他未经请求的建议打断了本已艰难的谈话。

entries.en: Her public sanctimony concealed a private habit of cheating suppliers.
entries.zh: 她公开表现得道貌岸然，私下里却惯于欺骗供应商。

entries.en: The botanist examined a small tubercle on the cactus stem.
entries.zh: 植物学家检查了仙人掌茎上的一个小瘤状突起。

entries.meaningZh: 已支付给民众钱款的收回
entries.en: The agreement permits a clawback of bonuses paid on inaccurate accounts.
entries.zh: 这份协议允许收回依据不准确账目发放的奖金。

entries.en: The meany hid the ball so nobody else could play.
entries.zh: 那个坏家伙藏起了球，让别人都玩不了。

entries.en: Persistent pruritus kept the patient awake throughout the night.
entries.zh: 持续的瘙痒使患者整夜无法入睡。

entries.en: He stopped eating when he felt the first signs of satiation.
entries.zh: 刚感到有些饱足时，他就停止了进食。

entries.en: Could you reword the question so younger pupils can understand it?
entries.zh: 你能换个方式表达这个问题，让年龄较小的学生也能理解吗？

entries.en: The foulness of the plot became clear when the forged evidence emerged.
entries.zh: 伪造的证据出现后，这场阴谋的卑鄙便显露出来。

entries.en: The socks were knitted from fine lisle rather than wool.
entries.zh: 这些袜子是用细莱尔线而非羊毛织成的。

entries.en: Her grandniece sent a photograph from the first day of school.
entries.zh: 她的侄孙女寄来了一张开学第一天的照片。

entries.en: The sermon contrasted sinful humanity with a sinless divine figure.
entries.zh: 这篇布道把有罪的人类与无罪的神圣形象作了对照。

entries.en: The course helped students prepare vocationally for work in engineering.
entries.zh: 这门课程帮助学生为从事工程工作做好职业准备。

entries.en: The geneticist compared autosomal markers from the two samples.
entries.zh: 遗传学家比较了两个样本的常染色体标记。

entries.en: She pulled the ribbon and, presto, the folded box sprang open.
entries.zh: 她一拉丝带，折叠的盒子立刻弹开了。

entries.en: The diagram illustrates transduction of genetic material between bacterial cells.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了细菌细胞之间遗传物质的转导。

entries.en: The test showed that the plant was heterozygous at this locus.
entries.zh: 检测显示，这株植物在这个基因座上是杂合的。

entries.en: The instructor began with a series of slow yogic breathing exercises.
entries.zh: 教练先做了一系列缓慢的瑜伽呼吸练习。

entries.en: The brilliancy of the polished stone caught every visitor's eye.
entries.zh: 抛光石头的光辉吸引了每位访客的目光。

entries.en: The artificer repaired the clock's tiny gears under a magnifying lens.
entries.zh: 技工在放大镜下修理了钟表的微小齿轮。

entries.meaningZh: 供电线或水管等通过的槽隙
entries.en: The plumber entered the crawlspace beneath the kitchen to inspect a leaking pipe.
entries.zh: 水管工进入厨房下面的狭小空间，检查漏水的管道。

entries.en: The acceptor signed the bill and agreed to pay it at maturity.
entries.zh: 承兑人在汇票上签字，同意到期付款。

entries.en: The evanescence of the mist revealed the hills beyond the lake.
entries.zh: 雾气逐渐消散，露出了湖那边的山丘。

entries.en: The hot popover broke open to reveal a hollow center.
entries.zh: 热腾腾的膨松饼掰开后，露出了中间的空心部分。

entries.en: His linguistic purism made him reject common loanwords in the manuscript.
entries.zh: 他的语言纯正主义使他拒绝在手稿中使用常见的外来词。

entries.en: The wastefulness of leaving every light on annoyed the caretaker.
entries.zh: 把所有灯都开着的浪费行为让管理员很恼火。

entries.en: They spoke secretively behind a closed door until the visitors left.
entries.zh: 他们关着门秘密交谈，直到访客离开。

entries.en: The assistant nodded submissively and returned to the unfinished task.
entries.zh: 助手顺从地点点头，回去继续未完成的工作。

entries.en: One mispronunciation changed the meaning of the entire sentence.
entries.zh: 一处发音错误改变了整个句子的意思。

entries.en: The singers began to vocalise before attempting the difficult passage.
entries.zh: 歌手们在尝试困难的乐段前先开始练声。

entries.en: The pamphlet proposed a communistic system of collective ownership.
entries.zh: 这本小册子提出了一种集体所有的共产主义制度。

entries.en: The microscope revealed a narrow tubule running through the tissue.
entries.zh: 显微镜显示，一根狭窄的小管穿过这块组织。

entries.en: His wimpish refusal to complain left the faulty heater unrepaired.
entries.zh: 他懦弱地不肯提出投诉，导致有故障的暖气一直没修。

entries.en: Water flowed wastefully from the broken tap all afternoon.
entries.zh: 整个下午，水都从坏掉的水龙头中白白流走。

entries.en: She felt unutterably relieved when the missing dog came home.
entries.zh: 失踪的狗回家时，她感到难以言表的宽慰。

entries.en: The clerk's surliness discouraged customers from asking further questions.
entries.zh: 店员的粗鲁使顾客不愿再问问题。

entries.en: A scow carried gravel along the canal to the building site.
entries.zh: 一艘平底驳船沿运河把碎石运到建筑工地。

entries.en: The lecture on theodicy examined religious responses to suffering and evil.
entries.zh: 这堂关于神正论的课考察了宗教对苦难与邪恶的回应。

entries.en: The pathology report identified the tumor as rhabdomyosarcoma.
entries.zh: 病理报告将这个肿瘤确认为横纹肌肉瘤。

entries.en: The coach delivered a hortatory speech before the decisive match.
entries.zh: 教练在决定性的比赛前发表了一番激励人心的讲话。

entries.en: The stacker arranged the crates in stable rows near the loading bay.
entries.zh: 堆垛工在装卸区附近把板条箱稳固地排成几行。

entries.en: The anatomy model shows the position of each testis.
entries.zh: 这个解剖模型显示了每侧睾丸的位置。

entries.en: The bareness of his feet surprised the guests at the formal dinner.
entries.zh: 他光着脚，这让正式晚宴上的宾客感到惊讶。

entries.en: An autodidact, she learned to repair radios from manuals and practice.
entries.zh: 她是个自学者，通过阅读手册和实践学会了修理收音机。

entries.en: The committee rejected the retrogressive proposal to restrict access to education.
entries.zh: 委员会否决了限制受教育机会这一倒退的提案。

entries.en: The diagram shows how sound waves reach the tympanum.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了声波如何到达鼓膜。

entries.en: The factory installed a precipitator to remove dust from exhaust gases.
entries.zh: 工厂安装了一台沉淀器，以去除废气中的粉尘。

entries.en: She read the list tonelessly, without emphasizing any name.
entries.zh: 她平板地念着名单，没有强调任何一个名字。

entries.en: The team paused to reorientate the map after losing the trail.
entries.zh: 队伍迷失小路后停了下来，重新确定地图的方向。

entries.en: The spacewalker secured a tether before moving away from the hatch.
entries.zh: 太空漫步者系好安全绳后才离开舱口。

entries.en: The judge's financial interest in the company prompted a request for recusal.
entries.zh: 法官在该公司的经济利益引发了要求其回避的申请。

entries.en: The seedlings began promisingly but struggled during the dry summer.
entries.zh: 幼苗起初长势喜人，但在干旱的夏季生长艰难。

entries.en: Wild berries grew plentifully along the sunny edge of the woods.
entries.zh: 野浆果在树林阳光充足的边缘大量生长。

entries.en: The microscope image reveals the neuron's dendritic branches.
entries.zh: 显微镜图像显示了这个神经元的树枝状分支。

entries.en: The chair summed up the disagreement pithily in a single sentence.
entries.zh: 主席用一句话简洁有力地概括了分歧。

entries.en: The researchers tested whether the compound had cytotoxic effects on cultured cells.
entries.zh: 研究人员检测了这种化合物是否对培养细胞具有细胞毒性作用。

entries.en: He snidely asked whether I had finally learned to read a timetable.
entries.zh: 他嘲讽地问我是不是终于学会看时刻表了。

entries.en: Her declamatory delivery gave the short speech an air of grandeur.
entries.zh: 她慷慨激昂的表达让这篇短演说显得气势恢宏。

entries.en: The exercise challenges proprioceptive awareness by asking participants to balance with closed eyes.
entries.zh: 这项练习要求参与者闭眼保持平衡，以考验本体感受能力。

entries.en: We turned and walked homewards when dark clouds covered the ridge.
entries.zh: 乌云盖住山脊时，我们转身往家走。

entries.en: The soldiers moved supplies in an unarmored truck.
entries.zh: 士兵们用一辆非装甲卡车运送物资。

entries.en: The repaired engine ran gratifyingly smoothly during the first trial.
entries.zh: 修好的发动机在第一次试运转时运行平稳，令人满意。

entries.en: An anonymous review process helped reduce prejudgment based on an author's reputation.
entries.zh: 匿名评审流程有助于减少根据作者名声作出的预先判断。

entries.en: The shelter keeps photographs of adoptable dogs beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 收容所在入口旁放着可收养犬只的照片。

entries.en: The committee's impotency became obvious when it could not enforce its own rules.
entries.zh: 委员会连自己的规定都无法执行，其无力便显而易见了。

entries.en: The congregation stood to sing the doxology together.
entries.zh: 会众起立，一同唱起赞美上帝的颂歌。

entries.en: He hypocritically condemned gambling while secretly running a betting club.
entries.zh: 他假惺惺地谴责赌博，却暗中经营着一家博彩俱乐部。

entries.en: The grabby partner demanded a larger share after doing the least work.
entries.zh: 那个贪婪的合伙人干活最少，却要求分得更多。

entries.en: The guards used threats and beatings to brutalise the prisoners.
entries.zh: 守卫用威胁和殴打残酷对待囚犯。

entries.en: I dropped a loonie into the parking meter.
entries.zh: 我往停车计时收费器里投了一枚一加元硬币。

entries.en: The lighthouse shone undimmed through the long winter night.
entries.zh: 灯塔在漫长的冬夜里始终明亮地照耀着。

entries.en: A jitney carried us from the market to the harbor.
entries.zh: 一辆小公共汽车把我们从市场送到了港口。

entries.en: The loose ferrule rattled against the wooden handle.
entries.zh: 松动的套圈碰着木柄，发出咔嗒声。

entries.en: Small birds flitter among the branches outside my window.
entries.zh: 小鸟在我窗外的树枝间飞来飞去。

entries.en: Her smartness showed in the quick solution she found to the puzzle.
entries.zh: 她迅速解开难题，显出了机灵。

entries.en: The warm room and heavy meal produced an overwhelming somnolence.
entries.zh: 温暖的房间和丰盛的一餐让人困倦得难以抵挡。

entries.en: She made a disappointed moue when the last cake was gone.
entries.zh: 看到最后一块蛋糕也没了，她失望地撅起了嘴。

entries.en: The chairman pompously announced a rule everyone had already agreed to.
entries.zh: 主席大模大样地宣布了一条大家早已同意的规则。

entries.en: The mask's grotesquerie unsettled visitors more than its bright colors did.
entries.zh: 面具的怪异感比它鲜艳的颜色更让访客感到不安。

entries.en: The vines grew luxuriantly over the abandoned greenhouse.
entries.zh: 藤蔓在废弃温室上茂盛地生长。

entries.en: The host's politesse helped the nervous visitors feel welcome.
entries.zh: 主人的彬彬有礼让紧张的访客感到受欢迎。

entries.en: She replaced the broken wedgie with a flat sandal.
entries.zh: 她把那只坏掉的坡跟女鞋换成了平底凉鞋。

entries.en: The dated photograph incontrovertibly places the car outside the building.
entries.zh: 这张标有日期的照片无可辩驳地证明，那辆车当时在楼外。

entries.en: A dwarfish tree stood alone on the windswept slope.
entries.zh: 一棵矮小的树孤零零地立在风吹的斜坡上。

entries.en: The villain grinned evilly as the door locked behind the hero.
entries.zh: 门在主人公身后锁上时，反派邪恶地咧嘴笑了。

entries.en: The hokey farewell scene made several viewers laugh instead of cry.
entries.zh: 那个做作的告别场景让几位观众笑了，而没有落泪。

entries.en: We interleave the photographs with clean sheets to protect their surfaces.
entries.zh: 我们在照片之间插入干净纸张，保护照片表面。

entries.en: The tailor cut the poplin into panels for a summer jacket.
entries.zh: 裁缝把毛葛裁成几片，用来做夏季夹克。

entries.en: The machine converts rotation into the reciprocation of a sliding rod.
entries.zh: 这台机器把旋转转化为滑杆的往复运动。

entries.en: The historical record describes a hospital caring for leprous patients.
entries.zh: 这份历史记录描述了一家照顾麻风病患者的医院。

entries.en: The photographer prepared fresh hypo before fixing the prints.
entries.zh: 摄影师在给照片定影之前配制了新鲜的海波溶液。
